en.subject: Accommodation Options for Our Wedding Weekend 🌿💍
en.intro1: We are so excited to celebrate our special day with you on October 3rd, 2026, at La Garriga de Castelladral! Thank you for confirming your attendance — it means the world to us to have you there.
en.intro2: To make your planning easier, we've put together a list of nearby accommodation options for your stay. Whether you're looking for a cozy rural house or a charming hotel, we've got you covered!

accommodations.name: Hotel La Garriga de Castelladral (Wedding Venue)
details: 20 boutique suites.
Special wedding rate: €178/room/night (day of the wedding), includes eco-gourmet breakfast.
Other nights: Standard rates apply, starting from €269/night.
Additional bed for adults: €52/night (includes breakfast).
Additional bed for kids under 12: €33/night (includes breakfast).
Crib: €25/night.
accommodations.note: Please note: A minimum of 12 rooms must be booked for Saturday night, so let us know as soon as possible if you'd like to reserve a room here.

accommodations.name: Cal Teixidor La Fusteria (Rural House)
details: Capacity: Up to 12 people.
Location: Village center, with private uncovered parking.

accommodations.name: Casa Cal Pastor (Rural House)
details: Capacity: 6–7 people.
Closed parking for two cars.

accommodations.name: Ramon Park Hotel
details: 40 rooms available.
Location: Santpedor, 18 km from La Garriga.

accommodations.name: Somnis i Arrels Hostel
details: Location: Castelladral, 5 km from La Garriga.

accommodations.name: Cal Moliner (Rural House)
details: Newly built rural house near La Garriga.
Location: Súria, 5 km away.

accommodations.name: Hotel Bremon (Cardona – 23 km from La Garriga)
details: Small hotel in the medieval town of Cardona.
Offers special rates for La Garriga wedding guests.

averageCosts: Rural houses: Approx. €30–€60 per person per night (depending on group size).
Cribs and additional beds: €25–€52 per night.
en.helpText: Please let us know if you need help booking a room or have any questions about the options. We're happy to assist in any way we can!
en.closing: We can't wait to celebrate with all of you under the stars at La Garriga de Castelladral. It's going to be magical!
en.questions: If you have any questions, please reply to this email.

accommodations.name: Somnis i Arrels Hostel

accommodations.name: Cal Moliner (Casa Rural)

accommodations.name: Hotel Bremon (Cardona – 23 km de La Garriga)
